arxiv-1907-06701.title: Output maximization container loading problem with time availability constraints
arxiv-1907-06701.creator: Pedro B. Castellucci, Franklina M. B. Toledo, Alysson M. Costa
arxiv-1907-06701.description: Abstract Research on container loading problems has been proved effective in increasing the filling rate of containers in different practical situations. However, the broader logistic context might pressure the loading process, leading to sub-optimal solutions. Some facilities like cross-docks have reduced storage space which might force early loading activities.

arxiv-2007-16018.title: Quantifying dynamical high-order interdependencies from the O-information: an application to neural spiking dynamics
arxiv-2007-16018.creator: Sebastiano Stramaglia, Tomas Scagliarini, Bryan C. Daniels, Daniele Marinazzo
arxiv-2007-16018.description: Abstract We address the problem of efficiently and informatively quantifying how multiplets of variables carry information about the future of the dynamical system they belong to. In particular we want to identify groups of variables carrying redundant or synergistic information, and track how the size and the composition of these multiplets changes as the collective behavior of the system evolves.

arxiv-2106-07247.title: Age of Information for Multiple-Source Multiple-Server Networks
arxiv-2106-07247.creator: Alireza Javani, Student Member, IEEE, Marwen Zorgui, Student Member, IEEE, Zhiying Wang, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2106-07247.description: Abstract Having timely and fresh knowledge about the current state of information sources is critical in a variety of applications. In particular, a status update may arrive at the destination later than its generation time due to processing and communication delays. The freshness of the status update at the destination is captured by the notion of age of information.

arxiv-2106-10917.title: Multi-Lah numbers and multi-Stirling numbers of the first kind
arxiv-2106-10917.creator: Dae San KiM, Hye Kyung KiM, Taekyun Kim, Hyunseok Lee, SeongHo Park
arxiv-2106-10917.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce multi-Lah numbers and multi-Stirling numbers of the first kind and recall multi-Bernoulli numbers, all of whose generating functions are given with the help of multiple logarithm. The aim of this paper is to study several relations among those three numbers.

arxiv-2107-00711.title: Formation of coalition structures as a non-cooperative game
arxiv-2107-00711.creator: Dmitry Levando
arxiv-2107-00711.description: Abstract We study coalition structure formation with intra and inter-coalition externalities in the introduced family of nested non-cooperative simultaneous finite games. A non-cooperative game embeds a coalition structure formation mechanism, and has two outcomes: an allocation of players over coalitions and a payoff for every player. Coalition structures of a game are described by Young diagrams.

arxiv-2401-11376.title: Self-supervised Contrastive Learning for 6G UM-MIMO THz Communications: Improving Robustness Under Imperfect CSI Thanks: The fundamental research described in this paper was supported, in part, by the National Science Foundation under Grant CNS-2148251 and by federal agency and industry partners in
arxiv-2401-11376.creator: Rafid Umayer Murshed 1 , Md Saheed Ullah 2 , Mohammad Saquib 1 , and Moe Z. Win 3
arxiv-2401-11376.description: Abstract This paper investigates the potential of contrastive learning in 6G ultra-massive multiple-input multiple-output (UM-MIMO) communication systems, specifically focusing on hybrid beamforming under imperfect channel state information (CSI) conditions at THz. UM-MIMO systems are promising for future 6G wireless communication networks due to their high spectral efficiency and capacity. The accuracy of CSI significantly influences the performance of UM-MIMO systems.

arxiv-2411-05190.title: Bipartite and tripartite entanglement in an optomechanical ring cavity
arxiv-2411-05190.creator: Oumayma El Bir, Abderrahim Lakhfif, Abdallah Slaoui
arxiv-2411-05190.description: Abstract Entanglement serves as a core resource for quantum information technologies, including applications in quantum cryptography, quantum metrology, and quantum communication. In this study, we give a unifying description of the stationary bipartite and tripartite entanglement in a coupled optomechanical ring cavity comprising photon and phonon modes.

arxiv-2504-19354.title: Neurosymbolic Association Rule Mining from Tabular Data Thanks: Published version available at https://proceedings.mlr.press/v284/karabulut25a.html
arxiv-2504-19354.creator: Erkan Karabulut, Paul Groth, Victoria Degeler
arxiv-2504-19354.description: Abstract Association Rule Mining (ARM) is the task of mining patterns among data features in the form of logical rules, with applications across a myriad of domains. However, high-dimensional datasets often result in an excessive number of rules, increasing execution time and negatively impacting downstream task performance. Managing this rule explosion remains a central challenge in ARM research.

arxiv-2512-15467.title: On regularity of compressions and diagonals of operator functions Thanks: The research was supported by GA ČR/NCN grant 25-15444K. The first author was supported by the Czech Academy of Sciences (RVO:67985840). The second author was supported by the NCN grant 2024/06/Y/ST1/00044. The second author w
arxiv-2512-15467.creator: Vladimir Müller, Yuri Tomilov
arxiv-2512-15467.description: Abstract . Replacing operators with continuous operator-valued functions, we prove time-dependent versions of well-known results on compressions and diagonals of bounded operators. The setting of smooth functions is also addressed. Our results have no analogues in the literature and rely on a new technique. The results are especially transparent for selfadjoint operators.

pmc-11712109.title: Preference Assessment in Dementia Care: Systematic Literature Reivew
pmc-11712109.creator: Hyejeen Lim, Young Min Choe, Jaeuk Hwang, Soo‐Hee Choi, Seong Jae Kim, Jung Hie Lee, Jong Inn Woo, Eun Hyun Seo
pmc-11712109.description: BackgroundBoosting shared decision‐making (SDM) for individuals with dementia is a critical aspect of patient‐centered care. This collaborative approach respects the autonomy and dignity of patients, even when they face challenges in communication or decision‐making due to their medical condition. Understanding patients’ values and preferences may be central to a successful SDM process.

pmc-11915362.title: Trabecular Wound Healing—the Nemesis of Trabecular MIGS
pmc-11915362.creator: Tanuj Dada
pmc-11915362.description: How to cite this article: Dada T. Trabecular Wound Healing—the Nemesis of Trabecular MIGS. J Curr Glaucoma Pract 2024;18(4):135–136. Minimally invasive glaucoma surgery on the trabecular meshwork (Trabecular MIGS) is one of the most popular forms of MIGS procedures worldwide.

pmc-12373741.title: Targeting spermine metabolism to overcome immunotherapy resistance in pancreatic cancer
pmc-12373741.creator: Hanshen Yang, Xiaozhen Zhang, Sirui Zhang, Yanqing Yang, Yan Chen, Yangwei Jiang, Qingsong Lu, Lingyue Liu, Mengyi Lao, Weiran Du, Kang Sun, Lihong He, Jiatao Shi, Xinyuan Liu, Jinyuan Song, Na Lu, Junming Huang, Jinyan Huang, Ruhong Zhou, Xiongbin Lu, Tingbo Liang, Xueli Bai
pmc-12373741.description: While dysregulation of polyamine metabolism is frequently observed in cancer, it is unknown how polyamines alter the tumor microenvironment (TME) and contribute to therapeutic resistance. Analysis of polyamines in the plasma of pancreatic cancer patients reveals that spermine levels are significantly elevated and correlate with poor prognosis.

pmc-12730674.title: Cytogenetic Abnormalities in Pediatric Myelodysplastic Syndrome: Insights on the Disease Biology and Impact on Leukemic Evolution
pmc-12730674.creator: Beatriz Ferreira da Silva, Viviane Lamim Lovatel, Gabriela Farias Lima, Giulia Miceli Giglio Rodrigues, Maria Luiza Rocha da Rosa Borges, Rita de Cássia Barbosa Tavares, Amanda Suhett Fonte, Patricia Regina Cavalcanti Barbosa Horn, Marilza de Moura Ribeiro-Carvalho, Maria Helena Faria Ornellas de So
pmc-12730674.description: Background/Objectives: Pediatric myelodysplastic syndrome (pMDS) is a rare, heterogeneous, clonal hematopoietic stem cell disease with a risk of evolution to acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Clonal cytogenetic abnormalities are present in 30–60% of pMDS. However, unlike in adults, the prognostic significance of chromosomal alterations, particularly their role in predicting evolution to AML, remains limited in pMDS.

pmc-12984972.title: The Natural Triterpenoid Alisol B Overcomes Temozolomide Resistance in Glioblastoma Through Multi-Target Mechanisms: Coordinated Epigenetic, Metabolic, and Cell-Cycle Reprogramming
pmc-12984972.creator: Yamin Zhang, Bingfang Shen, Chaoqun Zhang, Ziting Li, Lisha Li, Xiaomei Xu, Hongwei Li, Wenjin Lin
pmc-12984972.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive and therapy-resistant brain tumor, necessitating innovative multi-target strategies. Natural compounds like the triterpenoid Alisol B from Alisma orientale hold promise due to their polypharmacological potential, yet their system-level mechanisms are unclear.

pmc-13156088.title: Efficacy of the twin-block appliance for pediatric obstructive sleep apnea: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13156088.creator: Xu Zhou, Feifei Wang, Maolin Fan, Dan Yang, Zhifeng Chen, Chunbo Hao
pmc-13156088.description: ObjectiveTo provide an updated and robust assessment of the efficacy of the Twin-Block appliance in the treatment of pediatric obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). A previous meta-analysis indicated a potential benefit, but was limited by the quality of available evidence and is now outdated. This study aims to synthesize all current evidence, including recent high-quality randomized controlled trials (RCTs).

pmc-13246970.title: From force to resorption: mechanotransduction, osteoclasts, prevention
pmc-13246970.creator: Fulong Shen, Xiaohui Xia, Yineng Han, Mengfei Yu, Wanghui Ding
pmc-13246970.description: Orthodontically induced root resorption (OIRR) is a frequent and often irreversible complication of orthodontic treatment, characterized by the pathological loss of hard root tissue under sustained mechanical loading. The risk and severity of OIRR reflect the interplay between mechanical variables (force magnitude, direction, and duration) and patient-specific biological susceptibility.

pmc-13347538.title: A glimpse of the end-of-life of people with Parkinson's disease and atypical parkinsonism: A descriptive analysis of electronic health records
pmc-13347538.creator: Herma Lennaerts-Kats, Anke Elbers, Catharina Muente, Rebecca van Stigt, Bastiaan R Bloem, Kris CP Vissers, Marieke M Groot, Marjan J Meinders
pmc-13347538.description: BackgroundThe needs of people with Parkinson's disease (PD) or atypical parkinsonism (AP) change significantly in the final weeks to days of life. A better understanding of this phase can help improve care.ObjectiveTo examine healthcare use and end-of-life care in people with PD.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective study (2022–2023) in three nursing homes, four hospitals, and eleven general practices in the Netherlands.

pmc-13373212.title: Sensory-guided human-machine joint learning accelerates the acquisition of motor imagery brain computer interface control
pmc-13373212.creator: Hanwen Wang, Yisha Zhang, Maxim Karrenbach, Yidan Ding, Bin He
pmc-13373212.description: Brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) offer the potential to restore function and augment human capabilities. However, non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG)-based BCIs still face challenges in learning efficiency and control precision, particularly for naïve users performing complex tasks. Here, we present a sensory-guided joint learning framework that integrates human motor learning with adaptive machine learning to improve BCI training and performance.

uslaw-usc-t43-s324.title: 43 U.S.C. § 324 — Assignment of entries
uslaw-usc-t43-s324.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s324.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 9 (Desert-Land Entries). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No assignment after March 28, 1908, of an entry made under sections 321 to 323, 325, and 327 to 329 of this title shall be allowed or recognized, except it be to an individual who is shown to be qualified to make entry under said sections.
